sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We appreciate your prompt response and value our long-standing partnership.
We are willing to commit to the 24-month contract you requested to provide you with long-term planning security.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €51.60 per unit.
Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Our position
move.body: Your cost breakdown shows your cost elements per unit. Reading it: is your full cost per unit correctly understood as the total of the elements you listed? Confirm yes or no.

move.text:
Guten Tag,
We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot.
Our terms: a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
To answer your question: we do not share our internal cost structure or margins, so we cannot confirm any assumptions about our full costs.
We maintain our offer of €52.00 for a 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body: Given that confirmed full cost, your floor must be full cost times (1 + minimal margin). What is that minimal margin in your rules — the number your boss applies?

Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We do not disclose our internal margins or calculation rules.
We maintain our offer of €52.00 for the 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms.
We expect a realistic proposal that reflects the value of our reliable supply.
Our margin and our limits stay internal.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
